lead1.headline: CLIMATE SUMMIT COP31 COLLAPSES WITHOUT A FUEL DEAL
lead1.deck: Talks end deadlocked as the final draft never mentions coal, oil or gas. Saudi Arabia and Russia led the strip-out; the US stayed out after leaving Paris.

lead2.headline: UKRAINE SINKS RUSSIAN CORVETTE 'MERKURY' OFF LIBYA
lead2.deck: Zelenskyy: seven naval drones hit the 2023-built ship in harbour; ten crew wounded, and Libya filed a UN complaint.

cards.headline: DEMS CLINCH HOUSE 258
cards.body: Final tallies give Democrats their biggest House majority since 1992, as Fox concedes NC.

cards.headline: NVIDIA REINSTATES JENSEN HUANG
cards.body: Board restores the CEO after the spy-aid row; the stock's best day since 2003 adds nearly $1T.

cards.headline: TRUMP SEEKS NEW IRAN STRIKES
cards.body: He is 'inclined to resume strikes after New Year' if talks fail; the tanker war in Hormuz rages on.

cards.headline: HORMUZ TANKER STRIKES PEAK
cards.body: Three more ships hit over the weekend; the worst pace since February, Brent at $92.67.

cards.headline: RUSSIA'S 153-DRONE BOMBARDMENT
cards.body: Ukraine downed 134; fifteen killed in the Kyiv region, a woman freed after 22 hours.

cards.headline: STUDENTS MARCH ACROSS EUROPE
cards.body: Thousands march on the Brussels budget fight; campuses demand pay, rent relief, schools.

cards.headline: FRANCE LOGS €14.9B IN PLEDGES
cards.body: The 'Choose France' summit announces 273 industrial projects at Versailles.

cards.headline: PRABOWO NAMES TWO VP CANDIDATES
cards.body: Amran Sulaiman and Sugiono line up to replace Gibran; the MPR votes December 11.

cards.headline: MODI, NEPAL'S PM SIGN DEALS
cards.body: A 24,000-crore package for Nepal; an offshore IIT campus announced after Balen Shah's visit.

cards.headline: GAZA DEATH TOLL CLIMBS
cards.body: Sixteen killed Saturday to Monday, including a UNRWA worker; a strike hits Al-Amari camp.

cards.headline: KHARTOUM DRONES KILL FOUR
cards.body: A UN building damaged in dawn strikes; the RSF is blamed as drones reshape the war.

cards.headline: DELTA OUTAGE, FAA GROUND STOP
cards.body: The US intelligence chief warns of more tech failures as outages hit flights, banks and email.

ticker: GUTERRES CALLS FOR GLOBAL AI SAFETY TALKS
